data.title: GE HealthCare Announces CareIntellect for Operations, Helping Health Systems Optimize Resources and Expand Access to Care
data.description: In Chicago, GE HealthCare introduced CareIntellect™ for Operations, an AI-powered Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution. This application, tailored for health systems, aims to predict capacity issues up to 72 hours ahead. It offers insights into potential bottlenecks on various levels within the organization. By evaluating numerous data points such as bed availability, patient delays, staffing, and wait times, CareIntellect™ provides a holistic view of emerging challenges. This tool is designed to enhance operational efficiency by utilizing advanced analytics to anticipate and mitigate issues before they occur. This innovation by GE HealthCare, listed as GEHC on Nasdaq, is a significant step towards proactive healthcare management.

data.title: Mitsubishi Electric Launches MECH-iC Chiller Platform to Meet Growing AI Data Center Cooling Demands
data.description: In WARRENDALE, Pennsylvania, a recent announcement was made regarding the launch of MECH-iC, a new magnetic-bearing air-cooled chiller platform developed by MEPPI in collaboration with MEHITS. This innovative platform is set to revolutionize the industry with its advanced technology and energy-efficient design.

data.title: Ralph Lauren Announces First Year Progress Against Its Timeless by Design 2030 Global Citizenship & Sustainability Strategy
data.description: Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) based in New York, announced their first-year advancements in the Timeless by Design 2030 initiative, part of their Global Citizenship & Sustainability (GC&S) strategy launched in March 2026. The details of this progress are available on the company's website and in the annual GC&S Report, emphasizing topics crucial to Ralph Lauren's operations. The company's Purpose, aiming to inspire a better life, guides these sustainability efforts.

data.title: Global Industrial Company to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
data.description: Global Industrial Company (NYSE: GIC), a leading national distributor of industrial equipment and supplies, disclosed that its CEO, Anesa Chaibi, and CFO, Tex Clark, are set to participate in key conferences. On September 23, 2026, they will attend the Sidoti Small Cap Conference, followed by the D.A. Davidson 25th Annual Diversified Industrials & Services Conference on September 24, 2026. The management team will engage in one-on-one meetings to discuss company operations and future prospects.

data.title: Riskified Brings Identity Risk Intelligence to Zendesk, Helping Retailers Stop Returns Fraud Without Sacrificing Customer Experience
data.description: In a recent development in New York, Riskified has integrated Identity Risk Intelligence with Zendesk's workflow. This integration will provide agents with immediate signals to address claims efficiently and reduce returns fraud. This collaboration aims to streamline processes and enhance the overall customer experience, ultimately leading to a decrease in losses due to fraudulent returns. By utilizing real-time data, agents will be able to make quicker and more accurate decisions, resulting in improved operational efficiency. This move is expected to have a significant impact on reducing fraud and enhancing customer satisfaction in Zendesk's operations.

data.title: Halliburton Awarded Bundled Deepwater Well Construction and Completions Contract
data.description: Houston-based company Halliburton (stock symbol: HAL) has recently won a combined contract for well construction and completions from Eni for the Cronos ultra-deepwater project in Block 6 of the Cyprus Exclusive Economic Zone. This agreement boosts Halliburton's presence in the Eastern Mediterranean's offshore sector and enhances its involvement in the region's critical natural gas initiatives. The contract includes services such as drilling, well construction, automation, and more, consolidating Halliburton's position in the market.

data.title: Paceline Equity Partners Fully Realizes its Investment in Kelso Industries
data.description: Dallas-based private equity manager, Paceline Equity Partners, LLC, announced the successful full realization of their structured preferred equity position in Kelso Industries, a key national provider of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) services. Paceline's investment was completely redeemed as part of a transaction involving a continuation vehicle for Kelso, led by the Company's financial sponsor, Peterson Partn. This realization marks a significant milestone for Paceline in the successful investment in Kelso, emphasizing the strategic approach that led to favorable results.

data.title: RLJ Lodging Trust Announces Dividends for Third Quarter of 2026
data.description: In Bethesda, Maryland, RLJ Lodging Trust (NYSE: RLJ) revealed a quarterly cash dividend of $0.15 per common share, payable on October 15, 2026, to shareholders of record by September 30, 2026. Additionally, a quarterly cash dividend of $0.4875 was declared on the Company's Series A Preferred Shares, payable on October 30, 2026.

data.title: Amerant Bancorp Inc. Announces Pricing of Senior Notes Due 2031
data.description: A Florida-based company, AMERANT BANCORP INC. (NYSE: AMTB), has disclosed the pricing details of its senior notes due 2031. The total aggregate principal amount for the Notes is $50 million, with an annual interest rate set at 7.00%. The interest is payable twice a year on March 17 and September 17, starting from March 17, 2027, until the optional redemption date. The Notes are a part of a registered offering by the Company.

data.title: Scion Closes Acquisition of Student Quarters, Capping 24 Months of Platform Growth
data.description: In Chicago, the Scion Group, the leading owner and manager of student housing globally, has completed the acquisition of the operational segment of Student Quarters (SQ), a student housing operator based in Atlanta. SQ manages around $1.3 billion in assets. This acquisition signifies the end of a significant two-year period of expansion and investment for Scion. In the last two years alone, Scion has invested more than $4.7 billion in various capital deployments.

data.title: Merlin Entertainments Elevates the Guest Experience Across Its Global Attractions with NiCE CXone
data.description: HOBOKEN, N.J.-- NiCE (Nasdaq: NICE) revealed today that Merlin Entertainments, a top player in the entertainment destinations niche, is utilizing NiCE’s CX AI platform, CXone, to enhance guest experiences worldwide. The move covers Merlin's extensive portfolio spanning 140+ attractions in 24 nations, featuring popular brands like LEGOLAND® Resorts, Madame Tussauds, and SEA LIFE, along with various regional thrill parks. By 2025, they are projected to continue expanding their reach.

data.title: LRN Launches Catalyst Policy to Transform Global Corporate Policy Governance
data.description: LRN Corporation, a prominent player in ethics and compliance solutions worldwide, has unveiled Catalyst Policy. This new compliance policy management solution is seamlessly integrated into the LRN Catalyst platform. It empowers organizations to enhance governance practices amidst the evolving landscape of AI-driven governance, risk, and compliance needs. Catalyst Policy streamlines and automates the processes of creating, overseeing, communicating, and implementing policies across various regions, languages, and regulatory frameworks.

data.title: Tickblaze and FPFX Tech Announce Strategic Partnership to Support Modern Prop Firm Operations Across Futures, FX, and CFDs
data.description: In Ottawa, Ontario, Tickblaze has revealed a new B2B partnership with FPFX Tech, a respected tech provider for the proprietary trading domain and the creator of PropAccount.com system utilized by prop firms worldwide. This collaboration integrates Tickblaze into FPFX’s tech ecosystem to cater to prop firms in need of a dependable, contemporary trading platform that complements their existing operational setups on FPFX infrastructure. This move is designed to support prop firms in a more efficient manner by aligning modern trading tools with familiar workflows, providing improved services to the Prop Firms industry.

data.title: Dynamics Square USA Completes Cloud ERP Upgrade for South Carolina Recycling Company
data.description: In Irvine, California, Dynamics Square USA has successfully conducted a Business Central cloud migration for a recycling company based in South Carolina. This migration involved replacing the outdated Dynamics NAV 2018 system that was no longer supported. This transition signifies a significant update in the company's technology infrastructure, ensuring a more efficient and up-to-date system.

data.title: Empowering Communities: ViiV Healthcare Awards $33 Million in Grants to Advance HIV Response in the U.S.
data.description: ViiV Healthcare, a leading HIV company owned by GSK and Shionogi, revealed over $33 million in community grants for the U.S. in 2026. This funding will aid 230 organizations in 110 cities across 36 states and territories, including Puerto Rico. The grants aim to assist populations most affected by HIV, providing crucial support services.

data.title: The LYCRA Company Appoints Hua Du as Chief Executive Officer
data.description: In Wilmington, Delaware, Hua Du has been appointed as the Chief Executive Officer of The LYCRA Company. With a background in leadership, Du aims to drive growth, innovation, and transformation within the apparel industry.

data.title: Viper Partners Represents Dr. Nicholas Sherock and Your Best Kept Secret Aesthetics in Partnership with Spa Medicca
data.description: Viper Partners, an investment banking and M&A advisory firm based in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, recently facilitated a strategic partnership between Dr. Nicholas E. Sherock LLC & Associates, Your Best Kept Secret Aesthetics, and Spa Medicca. Acting as the exclusive financial advisor, Viper Partners successfully brought together the two renowned healthcare and aesthetics businesses from Ohio with Spa Medicca's expanding platform. This collaboration not only merges the expertise of the entities but also injects additional capital and operational resources into the venture.
